help.title: Ways to pay your Mercury bill
paragraphs: Pay online in your customer portal or the Mercury app, where you can make a one-time payment or enroll in autopay. To pay without logging in, use One-Time Payment with your policy number or the email address on your policy.
By phone, our Billing Specialists take payments at (800) 503-3724, Monday through Saturday, 5 a.m. to 9 p.m. Pacific.

By mail, make your check or money order payable to Mercury Casualty Company, include your policy number and send it to Mercury Insurance Group, P.O. Box 11991, Santa Ana, CA 92711. You can also pay cash at MoneyGram locations.

help.title: What forms of payment are accepted?
paragraphs: Checks, money orders and cashier's checks; Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover cards; and electronic funds transfer from your bank, online or by phone. Cash is accepted only at select agent locations, not at Mercury offices.

If a payment is returned or reversed, coverage is cancelled as if it was never active, to the extent state law allows. Pay each policy as a separate payment. To split one payment across several cards, call billing.

help.title: Autopay
paragraphs: Autopay automatically deducts your scheduled payment on the due date so you avoid late fees. Enroll in your customer portal.
Need to delay an autopay payment? Call our billing department at (800) 503-3724.

help.title: Where can I find my policy number?
paragraphs: Your policy number is on your declarations page, your ID card and your bills. It may be two letters followed by eight digits, four letters followed by ten digits, or fifteen digits with no letters.
